brief: Pricing on OpenRouter moved in both directions today, but the split within single model families is the real story: Z.ai cut GLM 5.3 output price 52% while raising GLM 5.2 output price 67% in the same window, and DeepSeek cut V4 Pro 0813 input and output prices in half while hiking V4.1 Flash input price 500%. That is not a market trend so much as providers repricing individual SKUs as they age or get superseded, and Qwen did the same, cutting nothing while raising both Qwen3.5-27B output and Qwen3 Next 80B A3B input prices.

Reliability had a rougher day than usual: GitHub logged two critical-impact incidents hitting Git Operations, Pull Requests and Actions within the same stretch, and OpenAI had a 381-minute outage blocking new ChatGPT Work threads in its desktop app, alongside a shorter Anthropic Console data-loading issue. Meanwhile the MCP ecosystem kept growing fast, with 5,735 new servers added in a week, and the major SDKs (MCP, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google genai) all shipped routine point releases.
ElevenLabs and Harvey both opened large batches of roles this week, Harvey 70 in 14 days and ElevenLabs 50, with ElevenLabs notably shifting toward forward-deployed and enterprise solutions roles.
